description: Rodger with 24-pounder armament. Fort Rodney, 1778 Saint Lucia and the Pitons lie to the south-east, and on a clear day, Martinique can be seen to the north. Pigeon Island, only some 40 kilometers (25 miles) south of the French base at Fort Royal, Martinique, had long been recognized by the British Admiral Rodney as an important observation and defensive site.
